name: Demo Selenium TypeScript for NHS Wales
summary: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in TypeScript, driving a real Chrome browser against the live production NHS Wales website.
description: This repo demonstrates Selenium WebDriver browser automation testing with TypeScript and Node.js, using the real NHS Wales website (https://www.nhs.wales/) as a friendly real-world example. It is a straight TypeScript port of the sibling demo-selenium-javascript-for-nhs-wales repo, driving a real Chrome browser and running three real, assertion-based checks: the home page title, the About Us page title and headline, and the search results page content.
